name: Veggie Burger with Guacamole, Salsa & Lime-Cilantro Greens
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes (or cook patties according to package instructions). Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the cilantro. Add mayo, dressing, and chili powder; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate, then layer with a burger patty, guacamole, and salsa; close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
